setlist.title: Beat it on Down the Line

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Samson and Delilah** (2 reviews): After Uncle John's Band came a raging Samson and Delilah; the lights came up and the crowd danced; Samson and Delilah described as really hot in the second set [9][10]
- **Hell in a Bucket** (1 review): Hot Hell in a Bucket opener got the show off to a roaring start [11]
- **Dupree's Diamond Blues** (1 review): Dupree's and Dire Wolf are older songs making rare appearances in the unusual first set [11]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Cassidy had a pretty jam featuring Brent's lingering bells and buzzers, which he used around this period [8]
- **West L. A. Fadeaway** (1 review): Passersby in the next car thought the West LA Fadeaway playing was a radio broadcast [7]
- **China Doll** (1 review): China Doll follows Playin' in a contemplative turn, with Jerry contrasting Bobby's eagerness [18]
- **Truckin'** (1 other source): A Smokestack Lightning tease follows Truckin' [2]

## Setlist highlights

- **Jam**: with Playin theme [19]

## The recordings

- **gd84-05-06.sbd.hinko.18638.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 144 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1984-05-06.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.77302.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 145 min; rated 4/5 by 5 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the Charlie Miller transfer has his typically great sound; Reviewer describes the sound as good and crisp [10][16]
- **gd1984-05-06.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.107138.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 146 min; rated 3/5 by 5 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the Miller transfer typically great [15]
- **gd1984-05-06.152043.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 22 songs; 150 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1984-05-06.senn421-set2.unknown.29302.sbefail.flac16**: source not stated; 15 songs; 94 min [6]. Said about its sound: Uncle John's Band start is missing; level changes and cuts in Drums were repaired with Soundforge [6]

## Around the show

- Guests: Playin theme [1]
- Hall had small balcony platforms jutting out on the sides near the stage, as the reviewer recalls [9]
- Taping was done stealthily; the taper found no one to patch from before the show, so skipped the first set [6]
- Reviewer finds the second set even better than the good first set [10]
- Reviewer prefers 1984 for Jerry still being strong and Donna being absent from background vocals [14]
- Reviewer lists other favorite 1984 shows: 4-19, 6-30, 7-4, 10-20 and 11-2, but still wants this in the top ten [16]
- Reviewer wants more 1984 soundboards, such as 4/21 Philly, and notes a Playin' into China Doll with no soundboard [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd84-05-06.sbd.hinko.18638.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Darryl Hinko; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard to MC to cassette to DAT to CD, then EAC to SHN, done by Darryl Hinko [1]
- **gd1984-05-06.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.77302.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Transferred/Edited by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Nakamichi 550/Maxell XLIIS-90) > Cassette (Sony TC-WE475) -> Sony R500 (Pass Through) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude… [2]. Also: Cassettes came from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker, with a patch source from Gary Field [2]
- **gd1984-05-06.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.107138.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Nakamichi 550/Maxell XLIIS-90) [3]
- **gd1984-05-06.152043.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5M [4]
- **gd1984-05-06.senn421-set2.unknown.29302.sbefail.flac16**: source: Sen 421's > patched thru 3(?) decks > Toshiba KT-R2 Walkman > MAC (Sony UCX-S) > Sony TC-D5M > Soundblaster > Soundforge > CD-Wave > FLAC [6]. Also: Second-set Sennheiser 421 recording made by patching into other tapers' decks about fifteen rows back on the main floor [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1984-05-07 Silva Hall, Hult Center, Eugene, OR, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-05-07-silva-hall-hult-center-eugene-or-usa/) [20]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1984-05-06 Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1984-05-06-backstage-pass/) [21]
